item.title: Australia: SmartSat Project Advances Satellite Autonomy
item.description: Australia’s SCARLET-β project demonstrated mission-level spacecraft autonomy in orbit, enabling small satellites to self-plan imaging, inspection and resource management with reduced ground oversight.

item.title: Thailand: Smart Innovation for a Future-Ready Industrial Ecosystem
item.description: Thailand is leveraging AI, automation and smart innovation to transform industrial estates and laboratories, driving sustainable growth, workforce development and nationwide competitiveness.

item.title: Hong Kong Researchers Enhance Perovskite Solar Cell Efficiency
item.description: Researchers at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology developed a vacuum-deposited perovskite solar cell with improved crystal orientation, achieving high efficiency, durability and production potential.

item.title: Vietnam: Advertising Technology Powers Tourism Boom
item.description: Vietnam’s tourism sector is rapidly recovering and growing, with advertising technology enabling precise targeting, higher-value travellers and more personalised, data-driven marketing strategies nationwide.

item.title: Singapore: Advancing Applied AI with New Centre of Excellence
item.description: Singapore launched a new applied AI centre while outlining plans to strengthen national AI talent development, advanced sustainable data centres and resilient digital infrastructure under forthcoming legislation.

item.title: Australia: Embedding Digital Health in Tertiary Healthcare Degrees
item.description: Australia has launched a national toolkit to help universities integrate digital health education into healthcare degrees, strengthening workforce readiness for technology-enabled clinical environments.

item.title: The Philippines: Enabling Direct Digital Payouts for TESDA Scholars
item.description: Landbank has partnered with TESDA to deliver over 335,000 scholars’ allowances directly through secure digital bank accounts, ensuring faster, safer and more transparent access to their scholarship funds.

item.title: Hong Kong: 2026–27 Budget Accelerates AI and Innovation Leadership
item.description: The 2026–27 Budget outlines a tech-led growth strategy to advance AI adoption, research infrastructure, smart industry, and emerging sectors, strengthening its position as a global innovation hub.

item.title: Vietnam: AI and Data Economy Key to 2026 Development Goals
item.description: Vietnam’s Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh calls for a data-driven, AI-powered digital economy to drive rapid, sustainable socio-economic growth, foster innovation and improve citizens’ overall well-being.

item.title: Singapore’s Approach to Building a Resilient Digital Future
item.description: Singapore is strengthening its cybersecurity ecosystem through workforce development, robust defences against advanced threats and responsible governance of high-risk AI tools, ensuring national resilience and digital trust.
